title: GDG DevFest Warsaw 2026
description: A community-led technology conference for Warsaw's technology community on November 21, 2026.
keywords: GDG, DevFest, Warsaw, developers, technology, community, conference

cfpBlock.title: Share what you know.
cfpBlock.description: DevFest Warsaw is looking for practical talks and hands-on workshops from people who build, learn, and share with the community.
cfpBlock.note: Bring a real lesson, a useful idea, or a story worth sharing.

visitBlock.title: Plan your visit.
visitBlock.intro: Registration opens at 09:00 at Google for Startups Campus Warsaw, Plac Konesera 10.
visitBlock.metro: Take Metro M2 to Dworzec Wileński — Koneser is a short walk away.
visitBlock.surface: Buses and trams also serve the Dworzec Wileński and Ząbkowska area.
visitBlock.parking: On Saturday, street parking in Warsaw’s paid zone is free, subject to space and signed local restrictions. Koneser also has a 24-hour paid underground car park.
visitBlock.accessibility: The entire venue is wheelchair accessible, with step-free seating available. The Koneser complex also has ramps and lifts.
visitBlock.wifi: Wi-Fi will be available for attendees.
visitBlock.cloakroom: An open, self-service cloakroom will be available. It is not staffed or monitored, so please keep valuables with you.
visitBlock.accessibilityHelp: Need an accessibility adjustment? Contact the organizers.

blocks.title: What is a GDG?
blocks.description: Google Developer Groups are local communities where developers and technology enthusiasts learn, connect, and share knowledge.
